the role of BCL10 and NF-kappaB in MZ B-cell homeostasis and oncogenesis.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BCL10 is an important factor in the development of MZ B-cell malignancies, which are a subset of the most common lymphomas in humans.

BCL10 translocation in MZ lymphomas is a critical event in the pathogenesis of this disease.
